polar.shortDescription: Open glass, a water loop with white hardline tubing, and an exposed Radeon Steel Legend. Here the goal was to hide nothing.
polar.description: An all-white build made to be shown off, not hidden. Custom water loop with hardline tubing, white sleeved cables bent curve by curve, and a Radeon Steel Legend that sits as the centerpiece behind the glass. The client's personal touches made it into the build too: a custom nameplate, a toy car on the internal tray, all placed so nothing sits on display out of order.
polar.objective: Maximum hardware exposure with showcase-grade finishing, without losing internal organization.

specs.case: White Lian Li O11 Dynamic Mini V2 case

allframes-ultra1.shortDescription: Red-and-black theme with ARGB fans in a zigzag pattern and an exposed GeForce RTX. Build in its final stage, still at the shop.
allframes-ultra1.description: A black build with a red-tinted side glass and ARGB fans running a zigzag pattern that matches the rest of the case. TUF Gaming motherboard, visible Kingston memory, and a GeForce RTX mounted horizontally. Still being finished before delivery.
allframes-ultra1.objective: A red-and-black themed build with components organized for delivery.

aurora.shortDescription: Synchronized RGB across every component, with the lighting treated as part of the design, not an afterthought.
aurora.description: Here the idea was the opposite of Frostline: color everywhere, synced piece by piece, without turning messy. Every fan and every LED strip calibrated to run through the same color cycle at the same time.
aurora.objective: Maximum visual customization without losing internal organization.

pc-blueout.shortDescription: RGB fans cycling through the color spectrum, an exposed Gigabyte Radeon and Corsair power supply in a black case.
pc-blueout.description: A black build with ARGB fans in all three positions (top, front and rear) cycling through several colors. A Gigabyte Radeon GPU mounted horizontally, a visible Corsair CX650M power supply at the bottom, and a small decorative ghost figure between the motherboard and the GPU.
pc-blueout.objective: Internal organization with RGB lighting at multiple points in the case.

snow-build.shortDescription: An all-white Mancer CV500L case with a Ryzen 7 5700X, Radeon RX 6650XT and water cooling. Six fans lined up in a row.
snow-build.description: Built in a white Mancer CV500L case, with a Gigabyte B550M Aorus Elite motherboard, a Ryzen 7 5700X processor and an XFX Radeon RX 6650XT GPU. Cooled with a soft-tube water cooler, six fans spread across the front and top, all matching the case's white finish.
snow-build.objective: An all-white build with organized AMD hardware and liquid cooling.

frostline.shortDescription: A white case with a Cooler Master water cooler, pink RGB memory and an exposed GeForce RTX.
frostline.description: An all-white build with gold accents on the case, Cooler Master water cooling, an ASRock Steel Legend motherboard and pink/purple Kingston Fury RGB memory — the only saturated splash of color among the white fans. A GeForce RTX with white sleeved cabling and a Ghostface figure decorating the side of the graphics card.
frostline.objective: An all-white build with a single color accent on the RAM.

mistic.shortDescription: Sleeved soft-tube water cooling, a Gigabyte Radeon and Fury Beast memory inside a black case.
mistic.description: A black build with sleeved soft-tube water cooling, a Gigabyte Radeon GPU mounted horizontally and Kingston Fury Beast memory. A Gigabyte P650B power supply visible at the bottom, with RGB lighting concentrated on the cooler and the graphics card.
mistic.objective: Internal organization with liquid cooling and Gigabyte/Radeon components.

glacial.shortDescription: A black case with blue RGB, an ASUS Prime A520M-R motherboard and an exposed GeForce RTX.
glacial.description: A black build with blue RGB lighting on the fans and RAM, an ASUS Prime A520M-R motherboard and a GeForce RTX GPU mounted horizontally. Cables organized behind the tray, with blue as the build's single accent color.
glacial.objective: A build with a single color theme (blue) and organized components.

prism.shortDescription: Pink, blue and purple RGB fans, a Cooler Master water cooler and an exposed GeForce GPU in a black case with a side glass panel.
prism.description: A black build with a side glass panel and pink, blue and purple RGB lighting spread across the case's six fans. A Cooler Master water cooler with an RGB ring on the block, and a GeForce GPU mounted horizontally, fully visible through the glass.
prism.objective: Maximum visual presence with colorful RGB lighting throughout the case's interior.
